description: Utilities for working with context managers, including decorators and generator wrappers, used within the PyTorch project.

classes.name: _DecoratorContextManager
classes.description: Allows a context manager to be used as a decorator, handling generator functions and class decorations.

classes.name: _NoParamDecoratorContextManager
classes.description: A subclass that allows a context manager to be used as a decorator without parentheses.

methods.name: _wrap_generator
methods.description: Wraps generator functions to execute within a context manager, managing generator suspension and exceptions.

methods.name: context_decorator
methods.description: Creates a decorator that applies a context manager to a function or generator, with special handling for classes.
